validation.phone: Enter a phone number we can reach you on.

messages.PASSWORD_UPDATED: Your password has been changed. Log in with the new one.
messages.IF_THE_ACCOUNT_EXISTS_AN_EMAIL_WAS_SENT: If an account exists for {{email}}, we have sent a link to reset the password. It works for one hour.

register.title: Create an account
register.subtitle: One account to book at every branch.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.phoneOnly: Signed up with only a phone number? There is no email to send the link to. Ask the staff at the branch where you book to set a new password for you — then add an email in My account.

invite.title: You are invited
invite.lead: {{company}} invited you to join the team as {{role}} ({{where}}).
invite.createAccount: Choose your name and a password to join.
invite.loginFirst: You already have an account. Log in as {{email}} to accept.
invite.wrongAccount: You are logged in as {{current}}. This invitation is for {{email}}.

look.appearanceLead: The rings and fonts customers see on the home and branch pages. The brand colour is set above.
look.ringsAuto: Made from the brand colour. Add a colour to choose your own (up to 4).
look.sampleBody: Pick a day and a start time. Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
look.previewNote: Follows your choices as you make them. Nothing is saved until you press Save.
look.branchAppearanceLead: Each branch follows the company's look unless you choose its own here.

dashboard.staffLead: See today on the calendar, take walk-ins and phone bookings, mark payments, and close the day with the cash-up.

account.title: My bookings
account.lead: Your bookings at every branch appear here.
account.noUpcoming: No upcoming bookings. Open a branch to book.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.lead: The link may be wrong, or the page was moved.

booking.cancelLead: The time becomes free for others straight away. This cannot be undone.
booking.tooLateToCancel: It is too late to cancel online. Call the branch: {{phone}}
booking.holdHint: Press and hold for {{seconds}} seconds to cancel the booking

public.notFoundLead: The link may be wrong, or the branch is not open for online booking yet.
public.nothingToBook: Nothing can be booked online yet. Please contact the branch.
public.noTimes: No free times on this day.
public.loginToBook: Log in or create an account to book here.
public.guestLinkNote: After booking you get a private link to see or cancel it.
public.confirmHint: Press and hold for {{seconds}} seconds to confirm your booking
public.bookedLead: See you there. Show this code at the counter.
public.requestedLead: The branch will confirm your booking soon.
public.guestLinkLead: Use it to see or cancel your booking. Anyone with the link can open it.

dash.deleteLead: This cannot be undone. If something still uses it, you will be told what to change first.
dash.imageHint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 2 MB.

setup.name: Name
setup.shownOnPageHint: Turn off to hide it without deleting it.
setup.bookableHint: Turn off for repairs or to hide it from the booking page.

sports.title: Sports
sports.lead: The sports people can book here. Spaces, coaches and classes each belong to a sport.
sports.empty: No sports yet. Start with the sport you offer most.
sports.typeHint: Customers filter places by this. The name above can be anything.

courts.title: Spaces
courts.lead: Courts, pitches, rings, lanes, bays, tables or rooms: each is booked on its own. Open one to set its opening hours, price and rules.
courts.needSport: Add a sport first, then its spaces.
courts.afterAdd: Next, open it to set opening hours and a price.

coaches.title: Coaches
coaches.lead: Coaches can be booked for lessons, alone or together with a space.
coaches.afterAdd: Next, open the coach to set opening hours and a price.

hours.title: Opening hours
hours.neverOpen: Closed every day: nobody can book it yet.

price.title: Price
price.lead: Per hour. Below it: what each length people can book costs, from the booking rules.
price.notSet: No price yet: it cannot be booked.

classes.title: Group classes
classes.lead: Weekly classes keep making their classes 60 days ahead. Below: the classes of the next month.
classes.editLead: Once seats are booked, only the title, price and a bigger capacity can change.
classes.empty: No classes in the next month.
classes.fillIn: Fill in the title, seats and at least one weekday.
classes.weeklyLead: Repeats every week on the days you tick, with no need to set it up again. Classes are made 60 days ahead and closed days are skipped.
classes.editWeeklyLead: Upcoming classes without bookings are made again with these details; classes that already have bookings keep theirs.
classes.weeklyNote: Each class can still be changed or deleted on its own below.
classes.weeklyPanelLead: These keep running: the next 60 days of classes are always made, skipping closed days.
classes.stopLead: No more classes are made. Upcoming classes without bookings are removed; classes with bookings stay.

closures.title: Closed days
closures.lead: Holidays and repairs. Nobody can book these times; existing bookings stay, so contact those customers.
closures.dialogLead: Times already booked are not cancelled.
closures.classesRemoved_one: {{count}} weekly class without bookings was removed.
closures.classesRemoved_other: {{count}} weekly classes without bookings were removed.
closures.classesKept_one: {{count}} class in this time has bookings and was kept: {{list}}. Contact those customers.
closures.classesKept_other: {{count}} classes in this time have bookings and were kept: {{list}}. Contact those customers.

rules.title: Booking rules
rules.lead: The company rule applies everywhere; this branch, a sport or a space can change any part of it. The most specific one wins.
rules.sportLead: Leave a field empty to use the branch rule.
rules.courtLead: Leave a field empty to use the {{sport}} rule.
rules.noCourtRules: No space has its own rules.
rules.emptyInherits: Empty fields use the wider rule (shown in grey).
rules.resetDone: This rule now follows the wider one.
rules.branchLead: Change only what is different here; empty fields use the company's booking rule (in grey).

settings.title: Settings
settings.slugHint: Letters, numbers and dashes. It cannot change after you publish, so shared links keep working.
settings.slugLocked: Fixed since the page was published, so shared links keep working.
settings.regionHint: Times and prices on the booking page use these. Changing the currency does not change prices already set.

modeHints.both: With an account, or as a guest with name and phone.
modeHints.account: People log in or create an account first.

settings.approvalHint: New online bookings wait as “pending” until staff confirm them.
settings.policyHint: Shown before people confirm, e.g. arrival, cancellation and payment.
settings.provinceHint: Customers find your place by province in the list of places.

team.transferLead: They get full control, including the team and settings. You become a manager.
team.noMatch: Nobody matches. Try another name, number, branch, role or access.
team.noneChosen: No branch chosen yet. Find and tick the branches below.

overview.checklistLead: A few steps, then share one link on Facebook, WhatsApp or LINE.

steps.profile: Add the branch's address and description
steps.hoursPrice: Give a space opening hours and a price

overview.publishNeeds: Steps 2 to 4 are needed before publishing.
overview.ownerPublishes: The owner or an admin publishes the booking page once these steps are done.
overview.liveLead: Share this link. Bookings appear in your dashboard.

share.qrAlt: QR code for the booking page of {{name}}
share.sendTo: Send the link in a chat or post it:

overview.closedLead: Its booking page is offline and its team cannot use the dashboard. The owner or an admin can reopen it from the company area.

desk.newBookingLead: For someone at the counter or on the phone. Earlier today is allowed.
desk.pickCourtOrCoach: Choose a space or a coach to see free times.
desk.fillIn: Fill in who is booking (find the account) and choose a time or a class.
desk.afterStart: Completed and no-show become possible once it has started.
desk.cancelEmail: The customer gets an email with the reason if they gave an email address.
desk.noLanes: No spaces or coaches yet. Add them in Setup.
desk.customersLead: People with an account who booked here.

reports.lead: Bookings and money for a period. Times use the branch time zone.
reports.financeRule: Booked value = paid + outstanding (ended, not paid) + upcoming unpaid + lost to no-shows. Cancelled bookings are shown on their own.
reports.lostCancelledHint: Not part of the booked value.
reports.utilisationLead: Booked time as a share of opening hours. Classes count as booked.
reports.unpaidLead: Contact these customers or mark the payment when it comes in.
reports.noUnpaid: Everything that ended in this period is paid.

cashup.title: Cash-up
cashup.lead: Money marked paid on this day, by method and by staff member. Compare it with the till.

crash.title: Something went wrong on this screen
crash.lead: Try again. If it keeps happening, go back to the start and tell us what you were doing.

identity.holdHint: Press and hold for {{seconds}} seconds to save your details
identity.title: My account
identity.completeLead: Choose your nationality. Lao numbers log in with their phone; others with their email.
identity.tellStaff: At the counter, give staff this number or your phone {{phone}}.
identity.tellStaffNoPhone: At the counter, give staff this number.
identity.phoneLaoHint: Write it as 20 and 8 digits, e.g. 2055551234. You log in with this number.
identity.phoneForeignHint: Written 20xxxxxxxx (e.g. 2055551234). No Lao number? Leave it empty — you log in with your email.
identity.phoneInvalid: Write the Lao number as 20xxxxxxxx (20 and 8 digits), e.g. 2055551234.
identity.emailLaoHint: Add one to receive booking emails and to reset your password by email.

branchSettings.title: Branch settings
branchSettings.lead: This branch's own details. Brand, language and currency come from {{company}}'s company settings.
branchSettings.name: Branch name
branchSettings.photoHint: Shown on the home page and the booking page. Without one, the company cover is shown.
branchSettings.overridesLead: Each one follows the company unless this branch sets its own.

company.usersLead: Every account: customers and the team. Find someone by name, email, phone (2055551234) or number (CNO000042 for customers, ENO000007 for the team).
company.userSearch: Name, email, phone, CNO… or ENO…
company.setPasswordLead: For someone who cannot reset it by email. Keep the suggestion or type your own; they are logged out everywhere.
company.passwordSetLead: Tell {{name}} this password (it is shown only now). They can change it in My account.
company.homeLead: Every branch at a glance. Open a branch to run its day.
company.noBranches: No branches yet. Open the first one.
company.newBranchLead: It starts as a draft. Set it up, then publish its booking page.
company.linkHint: Lower-case letters, numbers and dashes. It can change until the branch publishes.
company.cloneLead: A new draft with the same setup. Give it its own name.
company.branchCloned: {{name}} created as a copy. Check it, then publish.
company.cloneCopies: Copied: details, sports, spaces with hours and prices, coaches, booking rules, weekly classes and coming closed days. Not copied: bookings, customers, employees and uploaded pictures.
company.branchesLead: Every branch of the company. Closing one takes it offline without deleting anything.
company.closeLead: Its booking page goes offline and its team can no longer use its dashboard. Bookings and setup are kept; you can reopen it at any time.
company.reopenLead: It comes back as a draft: publish it again when ready.
company.teamLead: The owner and admins run every branch. Managers and staff work at the branches you give them.
company.inviteLead: They get an email to join. The invitation is valid for 7 days.
company.adminHint: An admin runs every branch and the company, like the owner.
company.accessHint: Off: they can no longer open the dashboard (they can still book as a customer).
company.transferLead: They become the owner and you become an admin. Only the owner manages admins and can hand over ownership.
company.customersLead: Everyone with an account who booked at any branch.
company.reportsLead: Every branch added up for the period, with each branch's share.
company.settingsLead: The brand customers see and the settings every branch starts from.
company.name: Company name
company.regionHint: Every branch uses this currency and language; a branch may use another time zone.
company.bookingLead: Every branch follows these unless its own settings change them.
company.rulesLead: The booking rule every branch starts from. A branch changes only what is different there.
company.qrLead: Customers scan it to open this branch's booking page.
company.homeLinkLead: The home page shows your brand and every live branch. Put this QR code at the entrance, on flyers or on social media.

home.noMatch: No branch matches. Try another sport or province.
home.noBranches: No branch is open for online booking yet. Please check back soon.
